name: Lazy Girls Live!
source:
Three nukige episodes featuring Mio, Tsumugi and Yui respectively from K-ON!

The heroines are trapped in the web of a secret club.

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053363.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
本作包含3个拔作短篇，分别以《轻音少女》中的秋山澪、琴吹细和平泽唯为主角。

女主角们落入了某个秘密社团布下的罗网。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053363.html]DLSite[/url]]
